full_page.content:
1947, December 18
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
( from the Photo-copy) December 18, 1947
Miss G. L. Panyard 1705 Peck Street Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Doris Panyard:
Bles'd be God in all and each of His designs:
God bless you Miss Panyard, many thanks for your kind favor Recl and noted yesterday -- carbons, book, violin strings, etc.
May the divine Infant reward you shortly -- and in the end be Himself your reward . . . . A Bl. Christmas to you and yours and a peaceful, Happy New Year.
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
A Joyous, Blessed Christmas to all the Panyard lineup. -- old and yound big and little
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
